# Casa Antonio

> Two private apartments in one house in Kita-ku, Sapporo, about five minutes on foot from Asabu Station on the Namboku subway line. Book Casa Antonio A or B on Airbnb. This website does not take reservations or payments, and it does not publish a phone number or nightly prices.

Casa Antonio is operated by Kagami Planning LLC. The public contact email is admin@kagami-planning.com. Pages are in English, 日本語, 简体中文 and 한국어.

## Confirmed facts

- Address: 〒001-0038 北海道札幌市北区北38条西3丁目1-7
- Check-in: 16:00–23:00, self check-in. Lock instructions arrive from Airbnb after booking and are not posted here.
- Check-out: by 10:00
- Each apartment is about 65 m², with its own entrance, kitchen, Wi-Fi and washing machine. No Wi-Fi speed is published. A dryer is not advertised.
- Parking: one free space per apartment, suitable for a large car. The host or property management clears parking snow. Guests do not.
- No smoking anywhere on the property, including the entrances and parking. No pets. No parties.
- Neither apartment provides a cot or a high chair.
- Oil, salt and pepper are usually removed between stays for hygiene. Guests should bring seasonings they need.
- Damage is charged at actual repair cost, with a minimum of ¥15,000.
- Scores recorded on 16 October 2026, shown separately and never merged: Airbnb A 4.87 from 30 reviews; Airbnb B 4.95 from 22 reviews. Booking.com A 9.0 from 24 reviews; Booking.com B 9.7 from 26 reviews. Quotes on the site are excerpts. Check the listings for the current score.

## Casa Antonio A

- Ground floor. Two bedrooms and one living room. Maximum four guests.
- Beds: three single beds (90 cm) and one double bed (130 cm). The bedroom beside the living room has two singles. The farther bedroom has one single and one double.
- English: https://casaantonio.jp/casa-antonio-a/
- 日本語: https://casaantonio.jp/ja/casa-antonio-a/
- 中文: https://casaantonio.jp/zh-cn/casa-antonio-a/
- 한국어: https://casaantonio.jp/ko/casa-antonio-a/
- Airbnb: https://www.airbnb.com/rooms/1248284267045468378

## Casa Antonio B

- Second floor, about 25 steps with a handrail. One bedroom. Maximum three guests.
- Beds: three single beds (90 cm).
- Wood interior, a projector in the living room, and space to hang laundry.
- English: https://casaantonio.jp/casa-antonio-b/
- 日本語: https://casaantonio.jp/ja/casa-antonio-b/
- 中文: https://casaantonio.jp/zh-cn/casa-antonio-b/
- 한국어: https://casaantonio.jp/ko/casa-antonio-b/
- Airbnb: https://www.airbnb.com/rooms/1248260873560502499

## 日本語の要点

札幌市北区、地下鉄南北線・麻生駅から徒歩約5分の一棟に、専用入口のある貸切アパートメントが2室あります。予約と決済はこのサイトでは受け付けず、Airbnbで行います。電話番号と1泊料金は掲載していません。

- 所在地: 〒001-0038 北海道札幌市北区北38条西3丁目1-7
- セルフチェックイン 16:00–23:00。チェックアウトは10:00まで。
- A: 1階、約65㎡、寝室2室、シングル3台（90cm）とダブル1台（130cm）、4名まで。
- B: 2階、約65㎡、寝室1室、シングル3台、3名まで。手すり付きの階段約25段。木の内装とプロジェクター。
- 各室、大型車1台分の無料駐車場。除雪はホストまたは管理会社。
- 禁煙、ペット不可、パーティー不可。ベビーベッドとハイチェアはなし。
- 油・塩・こしょうは衛生のため、通常は滞在ごとに撤去します。
- メール: admin@kagami-planning.com
- 日本語の案内: https://casaantonio.jp/ja/
